paragraph: In December 2024 the chairman of the tax administration AGT said it [was moving to ASYCUDA World version 5](<https://pti.ao/agt-anuncia-migracao-para-novo-sistema-de-processamento-aduaneiro/>). In the last twelve months, the new system [went live at Lobito on 5 January 2026](<https://asycuda.org/en/angola-marks-the-operational-launch-of-asy5-the-5th-generation-of-asycuda-customs-management-software/>), and AGT [launched it at the Port of Luanda on 29 June 2026](<https://angop.ao/noticias/economia/agt-expande-sistema-automatizado-ao-porto-de-luanda/>). The 2025 UN trade facilitation survey [rates the automated customs system as fully implemented](<https://www.untfsurvey.org/economy?id=AGO>). No source found since October 2023 says a trade single window is in service. Operating would need a trade single window in service, joining customs and other border agencies.

The statistics institute's [2024 yearbook builds its trade figures from Sydonia World](<https://api.insbu.bi/storage/documents/01M0WF6F346CZ0KBK8A07YJVSP.pdf>), the revenue office's automated customs system. TradeMark Africa reports that [the customs systems of Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda and Burundi are interconnected](<https://trademarkafrica.com/one-stop-border-posts-save-eac-over-63m-annually/>). They connect through the East African Community Single Customs Territory Centralised Platform, unveiled in revamped form on 27 January 2025. In the last twelve months, the Office Burundais des Recettes [presented the new web version of its electronic single window on 17 February 2026](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/tech/le-burundi-digitalise-ses-procedures-d-importation-via-un-guichet-unique>). It is for import permits.

ECOWAS says [Benin's customs was connected to SIGMAT, the community's goods-in-transit data exchange system, in July 2024](<https://www.ecowas.int/for-better-knowledge-and-understanding-of-the-interconnected-system-for-the-management-of-goods-in-transit-sigmat/>). Benin's single window, GUCE, has been [in service since 2018](<https://douanes.gouv.bj/en/remise-officielle-du-guce-benin-au-gouvernement/>). In June 2025 Webb Fontaine said [Webb Customs had replaced Sydonia World, with customs procedures fully automated](<https://webbfontaine.com/news/webb-customs-the-new-digital-weapon-against-customs-fraud-in-benin>). In the last twelve months, ECOWAS [called Benin one of the first member states to deploy SIGMAT](<https://www.ecowas.int/the-third-group-of-the-ecowas-trade-liberalisation-scheme-etls-task-force-holds-its-inaugural-meeting-on-5-and-6-november-2026-in-cotonou/>) in November 2026. On 5 November 2026 TradeMark Africa [handed customs servers and firewalls to keep Benin's SIGMAT node online](<https://trademarkafrica.com/strengthening-benins-digital-backbone-to-keep-west-african-trade-moving/>).

ECOWAS says [Burkina Faso was connected to the SIGMAT goods-in-transit data exchange system in July 2024](<https://www.ecowas.int/for-better-knowledge-and-understanding-of-the-interconnected-system-for-the-management-of-goods-in-transit-sigmat/>). The connection is for its customs administration. The Direction generale des douanes and SOGESY [launched Sylvie 2 on 17 February 2025](<https://jumelages-partenariats.com/actualites.php?n=22833>), the electronic single window for import and export clearance. No change has been found in the last twelve months. The Togolese Revenue Office [announced the pilot phase of the interconnection of the Togo and Mali customs systems via Burkina Faso](<https://www.otr.tg/index.php/fr/blog/avis-communiques/1431-avis-aux-operateurs-economiques-n-004-2025-otr-cg-cddi-del-relatif-a-l-interconnexion-des-systemes-informatiques-douaniers-du-togo-et-du-mali.html>), operational from 10 March 2025.

In February 2024 finance minister Peggy Serame [said BURS continues to optimise its e-services](<https://dailynews.gov.bw/news-detail/77665>), including online customs declarations. In 2022 BURS's Principal Officer for Customs Reforms said [a new integrated Customs Management System replaced ASYCUDA++ in 2017](<https://mag.wcoomd.org/magazine/wco-news-97-issue-1-2022/how-botswana-customs-is-leveraging-data-driven-technologies/>). In February 2022 BURS said that system [provides a single window through its Other Government Agencies module](<https://mag.wcoomd.org/magazine/wco-news-97-issue-1-2022/how-botswana-customs-is-leveraging-data-driven-technologies/>), with other agencies at testing stage. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a trade single window is in service. Operating would need a trade single window in service, joining customs and other border agencies.

The Ministry of Finance and Budget's [proposed 2025 budget carries XAF 115,000,000 for support to the deployment of SYDONIA World](<http://www.finances.gouv.cf/sites/default/files/2024-12/3-%20PLF2025%2004%2012%202024.pdf>), the customs system. In the last twelve months, in July 2026, Investir en Centrafrique reported that [once the DPI fee is paid via Orange Money, the loading-intention declaration is generated automatically](<https://investirencentrafrique.com/2026/07/03/orange-centrafrique-et-webb-fontaine-lancent-le-paiement-automatise-de-la-redevance-dpi-via-orange-money/>). Data then goes in real time to SYDONIA on the eDouanes platform. No source found since October 2023 says a trade single window is in service. Operating would need a trade single window in service, joining customs and other border agencies.

ECOWAS says [Côte d'Ivoire's customs was connected to SIGMAT, the community's transit data exchange system, in July 2024](<https://www.ecowas.int/for-better-knowledge-and-understanding-of-the-interconnected-system-for-the-management-of-goods-in-transit-sigmat/>). GUCE CI, the foreign trade single window, has been [in service since 2013](<https://www.gucecotedivoire.ci/innovation-et-dematerialisation-dans-lecosysteme-du-commerce-exterieur-guce-ci-lance-sa-nouvelle-application-guce-mobile-tant-attendue-par-les-operateurs-economiques-les-acteurs-majeurs-e/>). In the last twelve months, on 24 and 25 September 2026 [Ivorian and Malian customs teams reviewed SIGMAT in operation on the Abidjan to Bamako corridor](<https://apps.douanes.ci/info/cooperation-bilaterale>). On 19 November 2026 [prior export authorisations for food crops moved online on GUCE CI](<https://www.aip.ci/cote-divoire-aip-commerce-exterieur-le-gouvernement-digitalise-la-delivrance-des-autorisations-dexportation-des-produits-vivriers/>).

[Cameroon customs has run the CAMCIS information system since April 2020](<https://bougna.net/2024/06/19/douanes/fongod-edwin-nuvaga-la-reforme-de-camcis-se-poursuit-inexorablement/>), with freight, clearance and revenue modules, its director general says. He [named linking CAMCIS with Chad's SYDONIA World as a priority](<https://www.theguardianpostcameroon.com/post/7286/en/homefluidify>). The single window, Guce, [issues customs duty receipts and clears imports and vehicles within 48 hours](<https://www.economieducameroun.info/echanges-commerciaux-le-guichet-unique-de-troisieme-generation-se-devoile-et-promet-de-nombreuses-innovations-aux-agents-economiques/>), on a platform dating from 2012. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says customs exchanges data through a system open to its whole regional community. Mature would need customs to exchange data electronically through a system open to every country of its regional economic community.

In September 2026 minister Julien Paluku said that [93 of 98 foreign-trade documents are dematerialised through the Guichet unique intégral du commerce extérieur](<https://desknews.cd/2026/09/17/rdc-julien-paluku-vante-la-dematerialisation-des-procedures-commerciales-pour-lutter-contre-la-corruption/>). Its system is connected to DGDA's SYDONIA World customs system. In the last twelve months, [an interministerial circular of 17 December 2025 set phased trials of electronic transmission from S-ONE to SYDONIA World from 29 December 2025](<https://fec-rdc.com/note-circulaire-interministerielle-relative-a-la-transmission-obligatoire-de-la-liasse-documentaire-du-systeme-informatique-du-guichet-unique-integral-du-commerce-exterieur-vers-le-systeme-informatiqu/>). It [generalised the obligation nationwide from 18 February 2026](<https://fec-rdc.com/note-circulaire-interministerielle-relative-a-la-transmission-obligatoire-de-la-liasse-documentaire-du-systeme-informatique-du-guichet-unique-integral-du-commerce-exterieur-vers-le-systeme-informatiqu/>). No source found since October 2023 says customs exchanges data electronically with another country. Mature would need customs to exchange data electronically through a system open to every country of its regional economic community.

In July 2025 the finance ministry said the Guichet unique des operations transfrontalieres [provides IT services for data exchange in dematerialised foreign-trade procedures](<https://www.finances.gouv.cg/fr/articles/visite-du-guichet-unique-des-op%C3%A9rations-transfrontali%C3%A8res-guot>). It [makes all trade actors' systems interoperable across ports, airports and land borders](<https://www.finances.gouv.cg/fr/articles/visite-du-guichet-unique-des-op%C3%A9rations-transfrontali%C3%A8res-guot>). In the last twelve months, [importers have declared on Sydonia and paid customs duties online through Fouta from 3 August 2026](<https://leconomie.info/congo-le-paiement-des-impots-et-taxes-bascule-en-ligne/>). The finance ministry says [FCFA 13 billion of duties and taxes was collected through Sydonia](<https://ecomatin.net/congo-107-milliards-fcfa-de-recettes-publiques-collectes-par-la-nouvelle-plateforme-de-paiement>) between June and mid-November 2026. No source found since October 2023 says customs exchanges data through a system open to its whole regional community. Mature would need customs to exchange data electronically through a system open to every country of its regional economic community.

The Direction Generale des Douanes says [SYDONIA World has been the central platform dematerialising customs procedures since 2018](<http://www.douane.gov.km/lire-actu.php?id=34&lang=fr>). UNCTAD says [the first phase of the single window, GUCE, has been deployed](<https://unctad.org/project/comoros-economic-integration-acceleration-programme-components-1-and-2a>). It is to be extended to more border agencies. In the last twelve months, [a finance ministry notice of 26 June 2026 said the PAGF project strengthened the interface between SYDONIA and SIGIT](<https://dncmp.km/official-journals/ceremonie-de-cloture-pagf-f916dcee>). No source found since October 2023 says the customs system exchanges declaration or transit data with another country's customs. Mature would need customs to exchange data electronically through a system open to every country of its regional economic community.

[ASYCUDA reports that Cabo Verde launched the ASYVAL valuation control module in ASYCUDAWorld in March 2025](<https://asycuda.org/en/cabo-verde-embraces-asyval-to-strengthen-trade-integrity-and-revenue-mobilisation/>), which flags deviating import declarations automatically. Cape Verde [hosted an ECOWAS mission on 18-21 November 2024 to implement the SIGMAT transit system](<https://www.mf.gov.cv/web/dnre/-/dire%C3%A7%C3%A3o-geral-das-alf%C3%A2ndegas-recebe-misso-da-cedeao-para-implementa%C3%A7%C3%A3o-do-sistema-sigmat>). In the last twelve months, in July 2026, UGPE reported [an upgrade of SYDONIA World at the customs offices](<https://ugpe.gov.cv/en/noticia/cabo-verde-digital-project-supports-customs-modernization-through-an-upgrade-to-sydonia-world>), including new customs modules. No source found since October 2023 says a trade single window is in service. Operating would need a trade single window in service, joining customs and other border agencies.

Djibouti customs says that [from 2 September 2025 free-zone operators and forwarders register and clear their declarations in SYDONIAWorld](<https://douanes.gouv.dj/module-de-prepaiement/>), with fees debited from prepayment accounts. In its [2025 to 2029 strategic plan, customs says it processed 205,678 declarations in 2023](<https://douanes.gouv.dj/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Plan-Strategique-Djibouti_2025-29_Short_Web_Page.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a trade single window is in service. Operating would need a trade single window in service, joining customs and other border agencies.

In September 2024 the customs director general said [ALCES, in service since November 2023 at border customs offices, had recorded 168,000 detailed declarations](<https://lalgerieaujourdhui.dz/les-douanes-optent-pour-un-nouveau-systeme/>). These were 70% of filings, the rest on the old SIGAD system. In the last twelve months, [a customs notice of 18 August 2026 put the electronic single window module of ALCES in service](<https://www.tsa-algerie.com/importations-les-douanes-algeriennes-lancent-le-guichet-electronique-unique-ce-qui-change/>), TSA Algerie reports. Commerce Ministry authorisations are now filed through it in parallel with paper. No source found since October 2023 says customs exchanges data through a system open to its whole regional community. Mature would need customs to exchange data electronically through a system open to every country of its regional economic community.

Egypt's progress report to the WTO of 3 May 2024 [says the Nafeza national single window is activated in most customs ports](<https://tfadatabase.org/en/members/egypt/technical-assistance-projects/article-10-4>). It is electronically linked to most of the border agencies concerned. In the last twelve months, in September 2026, [Nafeza was live in production with the Ain Sokhna truck yard system](<https://enterpriseam.com/egypt/2026/09/28/ain-sokhnas-new-truck-yard-is-already-linking-with-nafeza/>). The Finance Ministry [has begun surveying road-freight firms to register and link them electronically to Nafeza](<https://enterpriseam.com/logistics/2026/09/14/egypts-govt-is-bringing-overland-freight-into-nafeza-for-the-first-time-closing-a-gap-in-trade-digitization/>). No source found since October 2023 says customs exchanges data electronically with another country. Mature would need customs to exchange data electronically through a system open to every country of its regional economic community.

Eritrea's customs used [legacy software in use since 2007](<https://shabait.com/2026/01/08/eritrea-launches-landmark-digital-customs-system>), the information ministry's Shabait reported. In the last twelve months, [Eritrea inaugurated the ASYCUDA World customs management system in January 2026](<https://shabait.com/2026/01/08/eritrea-launches-landmark-digital-customs-system>) in its place. UNDP said [all customs stations are interconnected on an intranet for data exchange and processing](<https://www.undp.org/eritrea/news/eritrea-launches-landmark-digital-customs-system-modernizing-trade>). No source found since October 2023 says a trade single window is in service. Operating would need a trade single window in service, joining customs and other border agencies.

In July 2026 the National Bank of Ethiopia and the Ethiopia Customs Commission [issued NBE Account Numbers to newly licensed importers and exporters through the Customs Electronic Single Window](<https://nbe.gov.et/nbe_news/national-bank-of-ethiopia-streamlines-nbe-account-number-issuance-for-new-importers-and-exporters-through-the-customs-electronic-single-window/>), which joins the central bank to customs. The Deputy Commissioner told ENA that [the Electronic Single Window integrates more than 70 institutions](<https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_8388900>). Webb Fontaine says [its Webb Customs eCMS automates 27 Ethiopian customs offices, replacing the old Asycuda system](<https://webbfontaine.com/success-stories/ethiopia/customs-management-project>). The single window was cited and not changed in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says customs exchanges data electronically with another country. Mature would need customs to exchange data electronically through a system open to every country of its regional economic community.

An IMF AFRITAC Centre mission of 11 to 18 December 2024 [was to help interconnect SYDONIAWorld, the DGDDI's clearance system, with other CEMAC customs administrations](<https://douanes.ga/medias/actualites/140/la-dgddi-accueille-une-mission-afritac-centre-fmi->). In the last twelve months, the DGDDI announced [the e-DIEBS platform, attached to Sydonia World, to start on 30 March 2026](<https://novaafriquemedia.com/?p=1616>). The Libreville customs region was the pilot site, with a three-month transitional period. No source found since October 2023 says a trade single window is in service. Operating would need a trade single window in service, joining customs and other border agencies.

The GRA Customs Division operates the Integrated Customs Management System, [according to a 2026 article](<https://www.myjoyonline.com/understanding-ghanas-new-integrated-tax-administration-system-itas/>). Ghana told the World Bank's GovTech survey in 2025 that [its customs online portal is a single window](<https://datacatalog.worldbank.org/search/dataset/0037889/govtech-dataset>). ECOWAS says [Ghana was connected to the SIGMAT goods-in-transit data exchange system in July 2024](<https://www.ecowas.int/for-better-knowledge-and-understanding-of-the-interconnected-system-for-the-management-of-goods-in-transit-sigmat/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. The ECOWAS Commission says [a mission to Ghana on 21-25 July 2025 resolved technical and functional challenges](<https://www.ecowas.int/technical-mission-to-ghana-on-the-deployment-of-sigmat-between-ghana-and-cote-divoire/>) that had hindered transit between Cote d'Ivoire and Ghana.

The UN Global Survey of 2025 [rates Guinea's automated customs system as fully implemented](<https://www.untfsurvey.org/economy?id=GIN&year=2025>). ECOWAS says it [launched deployment of SIGMAT, its system for goods in transit, between Cote d'Ivoire, Guinea and Liberia on 31 October 2025](<https://www.ecowas.int/ecowas-strengthens-intra-regional-trade-with-the-launch-of-sigmat-between-cote-divoire-guinea-and-liberia/>). The three exchange electronic transit messages. They do so through the interconnection of their national customs systems. In the last twelve months the single window was cited and not changed. Webb Fontaine reported in June 2026 that [the Guinean Single Window for Foreign Trade, GUCEG, had operated for seven years](<https://webbfontaine.com/news/guceg-impact-360-highlights-seven-years-of-digital-trade-transformation-in-guinea>).

The authority's Commissioner General said on 30 May 2025 that [ASYCUDA moved from version 2.7 to ASYCUDA++](<https://www.gra.gm/news/57d06877-3d50-11f0-b086-029254d29bb1>). It then moved to ASYCUDA World in 2022. In the last twelve months, in September 2026, the president of the clearing and forwarding agents association said [the Gambia National Single Window has helped improve vessel turnaround and clearance time](<https://thepoint.gm/africa/gambia/national-news/govt-promises-duty-waiver-decision-in-72-hrs-with-new-digital-system>). The Gambia Revenue Authority states that [strides in implementing the National Single Window have improved inter-agency coordination](<https://www.gra.gm/news/26fd4242-17b6-11f1-b086-029254d29bb1>). No source found since October 2023 says customs exchanges data electronically with another country. Mature would need customs to exchange data electronically through a system open to every country of its regional economic community.

UNCTAD reported in January 2026 that [ASYCUDAWorld is operational across all computerised customs offices after migration from ASYCUDA++](<https://asycuda.org/en/guinea-bissau-launches-asycudaworld-to-strengthen-customs-digitalization/>). In the last twelve months, the customs administration [officially launched an air electronic manifest module in SYDONIA World on 17 September 2026](<https://alfandegas.mef.gw/dga-lanca-oficialmente-o-modulo-de-manifesto-eletronico-via-aerea-no-sydonia-world/>). On 8 October 2026 customs [reviewed its migration from SYDONIA++ to SYDONIA World with an African Development Bank mission](<https://alfandegas.mef.gw/dga-e-missao-tecnica-do-bad-avaliam-a-execucao-dos-projetos-de-modernizacao-e-formacao-aduaneira/>). The mission head said the migration had passed 80% execution. No source found since October 2023 says a trade single window is in service. Operating would need a trade single window in service, joining customs and other border agencies.

The Prime Minister [launched the Sidunea World customs platform at Bata customs on 27 December 2024](<https://realequatorialguinea.com/destacado/politica/lanzamiento-oficial-de-la-plataforma-digital-sidunea-world-en-las-aduanas-de-bata/>). UNCTAD ASYCUDA [reported in June 2025 that ASYCUDAWorld is fully operational in all Equatorial Guinea customs offices](<https://asycuda.org/en/equatorial-guinea-completes-nationwide-rollout-of-asycudaworld/>), enabling paperless clearance. In the last twelve months, in September 2026, PAMFP stated that [phase II of the SYDONIA customs software is to be implemented at Bata, Mongomo, Ebebiyin, Corisco, Aconibe, Cogo and Rio Campo](<https://www.pamfp.org/en/support-for-the-reinforcement-of-the-mobilization-of-non-oil-revenues/>). No source found since October 2023 says a trade single window is in service. Operating would need a trade single window in service, joining customs and other border agencies.

Business Daily reports that [the Integrated Customs Management System, adopted in October 2021, is Kenya's sole clearance system](<https://www.businessdailyafrica.com/bd/economy/kra-in-major-customs-income-tax-systems-upgrade-after-snags-5167392>). KenTrade says its National Electronic Single Window System [was upgraded and commissioned on 20 August 2021](<https://kentrade.go.ke/site/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/Revised-KenTrade-Strategic-Plan-20232024-To-20272028.pdf>). TradeMark Africa reports that [the customs systems of Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda and Burundi are interconnected](<https://trademarkafrica.com/one-stop-border-posts-save-eac-over-63m-annually/>) through the East African Community Single Customs Territory Centralised Platform. No change has been found in the last twelve months. [Scanner image sharing was first implemented between Kenya and Uganda in 2024](<https://trademarkafrica.com/one-stop-border-posts-save-eac-over-63m-annually/>).

The LRA Corporate Strategic Plan 2025-2029 [tables ASYCUDA's status as extended to Freeport of Liberia, RIA and Buchanan](<https://revenue.lra.gov.lr/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/LRA-CSP-2025-Final.pdf>). LRA Commissioner General James Dorbor Jallah said [ASYCUDA has been deployed to 11 of 17 Customs Business Offices](<https://smartnewsliberia.com/lra-unveils-new-strategic-plan-as-liberia-moves-toward-historic-us1-billion-revenue-mark/>). In the last twelve months, [the Ministry of Commerce and Industry issued a World Bank-financed tender on 9 June 2026 for the ICT infrastructure of the National Single Window System](<https://www.emansion.gov.lr/sites/default/files/documents/Special%20Procurement%20Notice%20for%20ICT%20Infrastructure%20for%20the%20NSW.pdf>). No source found since October 2023 says a trade single window is in service. Operating would need a trade single window in service, joining customs and other border agencies.

Libya's Customs Authority [announced on 21 August 2025 the full launch of the ASYCUDA customs system early the following month](<https://libyaherald.com/2025/08/customs-authority-announces-full-launch-of-asycuda-system-next-month>). The UN Global Survey 2025 [records e-submission of customs declarations in Libya as not implemented](<https://www.untfsurvey.org/economy?id=LBY>). The IMF METAC says its August-September 2024 mission [helped Libya Customs develop a National Standard Operating Procedure for the new automated clearing process using ASYCUDA World](<https://www.imfmetac.org/content/dam/METAC/Countries-Activities/FY25/Libya.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 shows ASYCUDA World declarations lodged and processed at a main port or border post. Establishing would need customs declarations lodged and processed in an automated system at the main port, airport or border posts.

In the last twelve months, [Lesotho launched its National Single Window on 24 August 2026](<https://swazi24.com/49844/business/trade-investment/lesotho-launches-digital-trade-platform/>). [Traders submit certificate, licence and permit applications there for imports, exports and transit](<https://swazi24.com/49844/business/trade-investment/lesotho-launches-digital-trade-platform/>). Revenue Services Lesotho and CAFI said [12 other agencies and 88 processes are automated](<https://swazi24.com/49844/business/trade-investment/lesotho-launches-digital-trade-platform/>). The report says it is linked to ASYCUDA World for customs declarations. No source found since October 2023 says customs exchanges data electronically with another country. Mature would need customs to exchange data electronically through a system open to every country of its regional economic community.

[PortNet's monthly report says it processed 191,388 Single Goods Declarations in June 2026](<https://en.7news.ma/portnet-processes-more-nearly-200000-customs-declarations-in-june/>). The report describes it as Morocco's National Single Window for Foreign Trade, connecting customs, ports, banks and businesses. In the last twelve months, Morocco's customs directorate [launched an international tender of about MAD 7.2 million to carry out the BADR audit recommendations](<https://en.expresstv.ma/2026/03/7-2-million-dirhams-for-upgrading-the-badr-system-and-enhancing-cybersecurity-for-customs/>). Bids opened on 16 April 2026. In August 2024 the budget minister said the customs IT system [is integrated with key partners in the foreign trade chain](<https://barlamantoday.com/2024/08/12/minister-morocco-to-use-ai-to-enhanced-public-services/>). No source found since October 2023 says customs exchanges data through a system open to its whole regional community. Mature would need customs to exchange data electronically through a system open to every country of its regional economic community.

In December 2020 Madagascar Customs said [TradeNet interconnects declarants, customs and banks](<https://www.douanes.gov.mg/nouvelle-technologie/>). GasyNet's chief executive says [TradeNet connects customs, control ministries and agencies and shipping lines in one electronic single window](<https://www.2424.mg/commerce-exterieur-gasynet-rapporte-un-delai-moyen-de-dedouanement-reduit-a-trois-jours-grace-au-guichet-unique-electronique-tradenet>), and has cut average clearance time to three days. The Ministry of Economy and Finance says the customs directorate and the Korea Customs Service [officially launched a project on 4 December 2024](<http://central.mef.gov.mg/page_personnalisee/index/news/1550>) to modernise the electronic customs clearance system. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says customs exchanges data through a system open to its whole regional community. Mature would need customs to exchange data electronically through a system open to every country of its regional economic community.

Mali's Director-General of Customs said the move to SYDONIAWorld in 2015 [built an integrated system that now covers over 95 percent of customs business procedures](<https://douanes.gouv.ml/node/535>). ECOWAS says [Mali was connected to the SIGMAT goods-in-transit data exchange system in July 2024](<https://www.ecowas.int/for-better-knowledge-and-understanding-of-the-interconnected-system-for-the-management-of-goods-in-transit-sigmat/>).
